summary: Alert heatmap hourly buckets shifted after tenant reindex; counts attributed to wrong hour and many trace links broken
description: Issue summary: After a tenant-level reindex that ran overnight for BrightRetail, the alert history heatmap in the Console shows hourly buckets shifted by one hour for a subset of alert types. Impact: alert counts appear in the wrong hourly column, alert detail rows sometimes have missing trace links, and a handful of scheduled cohort alerts did not fire. Timeline: 2026-03-10 02:10 UTC reindex completed; customer reported anomalies at 2026-03-10 08:12 local. Observed behavior: the heatmap hour labels are correct but metric counts map to the previous hour; trace link URLs in alert rows return 404; some alerts show as 'fired' in UI but not present in the alert-fire log. Expected behavior: post-reindex heatmap displays consistent bucketed counts and trace links resolve to trace view. Additional context: BrightRetail has high-cardinality tag use and long retention; reindex job used new compaction flags.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Run tenant reindex on a tenant with hourly rollups and high-cardinality metrics (reindex job with --compact-enabled)
2) After reindex finishes, open Console > Alerts > History Heatmap for that tenant scoped to the last 24h
3) Compare hourly bucket counts to raw alert-fire events in the alerting database and traces service
4) Click an alert cell and open the alert detail pane to follow the trace link

investigation_notes: Support reproduced heatmap shift in prod when comparing raw alert-fire events to Console UI buckets.
Hypothesis 1: Reindex altered the bucket_id hashing (timezone/rollup epoch offset) so rollup documents were re-assigned to an adjacent bucket.
Hypothesis 2: The reindex used an older mapping for trace references; trace-linker queries are pointed at an older index alias post-reindex.
Ran queries: SELECT count(*) FROM alert_rollups WHERE bucket_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-10T01:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-10T02:00:00Z' returned counts that disagree with Console UI mapping by one-hour offset.
Found indexer commit that changed bucket_key calc in commit abc123 (github PR #3456); PR modifies rollup epoch base when --compact-enabled flag present.
Trace-link 404s traced to alias swap: reindex job swapped alias 'traces_current' to point to new index but the console cache still referenced previous alias name for a short window.
comments: Maya Chen (Support) 2026-03-10: Logged after BrightRetail CS reported heatmap counts misaligned and 404s on trace links. Escalating to SRE. First response sent to customer with request for full tenant id and screenshots.
BrightRetail (Customer) 2026-03-10: Provided screenshots and raw alert IDs; noted some scheduled alerts did not fire for morning ET batch.

Arjun Patel (SRE) 2026-03-10: Reproduced in prod. Scoped to tenants where reindex ran with --compact-enabled. Correlating with indexer change in PR #3456. Creating INT ticket for indexer rollback verification.

Arjun Patel (SRE) 2026-03-11: Temporary mitigation applied: triggered a targeted rolling reindex for brightretail that re-generates bucket_key using legacy epoch base. Heatmap counts realigned after rollout; trace links resolved for retried alerts.
Maya Chen (Support) 2026-03-12: Notified customer of mitigation and asked them to confirm alerting behavior for the next scheduled batch. Customer requested root cause and permanent fix ETA.
resolution: Workaround applied: targeted rolling reindex for affected tenant restored legacy bucket assignment and replaced alias pointers for trace index. Root cause: bucket_key calculation changed in indexer PR #3456 when --compact-enabled is set; alias swap timing caused trace-linker to query obsolete alias for a short window. Permanent fix: revert the epoch-offset change in the indexer mapping and add a post-reindex consistency job that validates hourly rollups vs alert-fire events and repairs mismatched buckets. Patch PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3468. Plan: patch -> canary -> prod rollout next week.
